intro: Brewmeister Bilger is an intoxicated dwarven brewer residing in the cellar of the inn at Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Once an upright, sober defender known as Bilger the Straight-laced, the passage of grueling years and the tragedies of Lordaeron have led him to trade his former discipline for the bottom of a barrel. Today, he whiles away his hours tasting potent spirits and waiting on deliveries from distant lands.

sections.t: From the Light to the Barrel
p: Long before taking up the title of Brewmeister, Bilger was known across Southshore as Bilger the Straight-laced. Back during the height of the Knights of the Silver Hand and Lordaeron's proudest days, he carried himself with rigid, sober discipline among renowned figures in the town's tavern. The fall of Lordaeron, the Scourge plague, and the loss of so many comrades broke that stern resolve. Now, Bilger spends his days pacing the cool cellar beneath Southshore's inn, nursing hiccups and seeking out the strongest brews Azeroth can offer.

Despite his perpetual stupor, Bilger remains a discerning judge of spirits. He maintains an appetite for heavy dwarven moonshines and potent liquors crafted in the south, eagerly receiving special batches sent up the coast from distant ports like Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.
